```yaml
name: Update Ingestr Version

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'  # Run daily at 2 AM UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  check-and-update:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.21'

      - name: Get current ingestr version
        id: current_version
        run: |
          CURRENT_VERSION=$(grep -o 'ingestrVersion = "[^"]*"' main.go | cut -d'"' -f2)
          echo "current_version=$CURRENT_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Check for latest ingestr version
        id: latest_version
        run: |
          LATEST_VERSION=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/bruin-data/ingestr/releases/latest | jq -r '.tag_name' | sed 's/v//')
          echo "latest_version=$LATEST_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Compare versions
        id: compare
        run: |
          if [ "${{ env.current_version }}" != "${{ env.latest_version }}" ]; then
            echo "needs_update=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          else
            echo "needs_update=false" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: env.needs_update == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: update ingestr to v${{ env.latest_version }}"
          title: "Update ingestr to v${{ env.latest_version }}"
          body: |
            This PR updates the ingestr version from v${{ env.current_version }} to v${{ env.latest_version }}
            
            Automated pull request to keep ingestr up-to-date.
          branch: update-ingestr-v${{ env.latest_version }}
          delete-branch: true

      - name: Run tests (if needed)
        if: env.needs_update == 'true'
        run: |
          # Skip tests due to module download issues as noted in requirements
          echo "Skipping tests due to module download restrictions"
```
